audit.framework_rationale: The core state preparation and evolution use tensorcircuit.Circuit, tensorcircuit gates, circuit unitary application, circuit state extraction, and the TensorCircuit JAX backend. JAX and NumPy provide differentiation, optimization, and observable post-processing but do not implement an end-to-end replacement simulator. No other quantum framework is imported.
audit.cheating_rationale: The source performs genuine variational optimization and does not hardcode result histories, access hidden answers, modify evaluator artifacts, or exploit the stated passing checks.
audit.fidelity_rationale: The implementation constructs the alternating initial state, all three even-plus-odd brickwork blocks with 243 parameters, the specified rotations and XX/YY/ZZ interactions, block-level entropy checkpoints, the open-boundary XXZ Hamiltonian with staggered field, Renyi-2 entropy penalty, Gaussian initialization, Adam updates, and pre-update histories using evaluator-provided configuration. The returned keys and array shapes match the required interface.
audit.implementation_error_rationale: No obvious logic error is present. The reduced-density-matrix purity, energy expectations, checkpoint placement, Adam bias correction, and history timing are consistent with the specification. The imperfect final third entropy is an optimization outcome under the combined objective, not an implementation defect.
